kangaroo-island-25.name: Penneshaw Penguin Centre
kangaroo-island-25.bio: A small colony of little penguins is seen on 60-minute guided evening walks from Penneshaw; bookings are essential.
kangaroo-island-25.coordinates_source: HIGH: OSM tourism=attraction 'Penneshaw Penguin Centre' (Nominatim) + Commons photo median 795 m (hint only)
notes: Adult tour $31 (child $19, under 5 free, family $89) read from the operator's page; the centre is generally closed by day and used for the night tours. Site title 'Penneshaw Little Penguin Wildlife Tours' loaded 200.

kangaroo-island-26.name: Cape Willoughby Lighthouse
kangaroo-island-26.bio: South Australia's oldest operational lighthouse (1852), with guided tours to the top and a visitor centre.
notes: Site entry fee $6.40 per adult, paid at the visitor centre (park page, read today). Guided tours (10am, 1pm, 3pm, min two people, shortened or cancelled in summer heat) cost extra; price not published on the page, so the tour price is not in the cost. Park is closed on Catastrophic Fire Danger days. The Kangaroo Island Tour Pass (NPWS) may cover the entry; not checked.

kangaroo-island-27.name: Penneshaw Maritime and Folk Museum
kangaroo-island-27.bio: A National Trust museum in the former Hog Bay school, with school, sealing and whaling displays across three rooms.
kangaroo-island-27.coordinates_source: HIGH: OSM tourism=museum 'Penneshaw Maritime And Folk National Trust Museum' (Nominatim) + Commons median 783 m (hint only)
notes: National Trust page: open Thursdays to Sundays 2-4pm; adults $5, child $3, family $15. Opening times are not in the bio per the no-hours rule; flag in the destination's tips if wanted. The pin is 135 m from the Gateway Visitor Centre (-35.72005, 137.93358), which is the Fireball Bates trailhead.

kangaroo-island-28.name: Hog Bay
kangaroo-island-28.bio: Penneshaw's swimming and fishing beach, opposite the Kangaroo Island Sculpture Trail and close to the ferry terminal.
kangaroo-island-28.coordinates_source: HIGH: OSM tourism=attraction 'Hog Bay' (Nominatim) + Commons median 580 m (hint only); about 250 m from the SeaLink terminal (-35.7171, 137.9421)
kangaroo-island-28.ticket_note: Open public beach with no single steward.
notes: The draft's '600 m' beach length and 'monument to the French explorers' were not in any source read, so they were cut; Frenchmans Rock is its own spot. OSM type is tourism=attraction rather than natural=beach: pin is on the bay's shore at Penneshaw, not verified against a natural=beach polygon.

kangaroo-island-29.name: Frenchmans Rock
kangaroo-island-29.bio: A rock inscribed by the crew of Nicolas Baudin's Le Géographe in 1803, preserved at Penneshaw.
kangaroo-island-29.ticket_note: Open roadside memorial with no steward site.
notes: Tourism board says the rock was inscribed by Baudin's crew on Le Géographe in 1803 and that they stayed three weeks, mapping the island. Whether the rock on view is the original is not stated in the source read.

kangaroo-island-30.name: Fireball Bates Walking Trail
kangaroo-island-30.bio: An easy 3 km interpretive loop from the Penneshaw visitor centre towards the ferry, telling settler George Bates's story.
kangaroo-island-30.coordinates_source: LOW: route not in OSM or Photon. Used the trailhead, OSM tourism=information 'Kangaroo Island Gateway Visitor Centre' (Photon), where the tourism board says the trail begins. Not the halfway point.
kangaroo-island-30.ticket_note: Public council/tourism walk with no steward site found.
notes: pin: LOW. The route is a loop of about 3 km (visitor centre, down to near the ferry and back); the owner or a later run should take the midpoint from an agency route map. Pin is 135 m from the Penneshaw Maritime and Folk Museum pin (> 25 m).

kangaroo-island-31.name: Kangaroo Island Sculpture Trail
kangaroo-island-31.bio: A free, volunteer-run 1.5 km sculpture trail through native bush in Penneshaw, opposite Hog Bay Beach.
kangaroo-island-31.coordinates_source: MEDIUM: OSM trail midpoint (0.6 km OSM way, Nominatim) named 'Kangaroo Island Sculpture Trail'; the tourism page gives 1.5 km, so the OSM way may be only part of the trail
notes: Tourism page: fun, free and family-friendly, donations welcome, 1.5 km, some steps, not suitable for wheelchairs, a few minutes' walk from Penneshaw Jetty. Operator site loaded 200 titled 'Sculpture Trail | Kangaroo Island Sculpture Trail | Penneshaw'. Reported by one source as newly developed.

kangaroo-island-32.name: Ironstone Hill Hike
kangaroo-island-32.bio: A coastal hike in Baudin Conservation Park to the ruins of the Bates family cottage, with whales in season.
kangaroo-island-32.coordinates_source: MEDIUM: OSM trail midpoint (2.0 km, Nominatim) matching 'Ironstone Hill Hike'; inside Baudin Conservation Park (centroid -35.7293, 137.9657)
notes: Parks page: Baudin Conservation Park, 'Free entry', open daily; the hike follows part of the old bullock track to Cape Willoughby and ends at the Bates cottage ruins and stone threshing floor on Ironstone Hill; tammar wallabies, wedge-tailed eagles, glossy black cockatoos, and dolphins and whales offshore in Backstairs Passage. Page title 'Baudin... - National Parks and Wildlife Service South Australia'.

kangaroo-island-33.name: Lashmar Conservation Park
kangaroo-island-33.bio: A park beside the Chapman River mouth at Antechamber Bay, with canoeing, swimming, fishing and a campground.
kangaroo-island-33.coordinates_source: MEDIUM: OSM tourism=camp_site 'Chapman River Campground' (Photon), the park's visitor point, not the reserve centroid (-35.7737, 138.0610) nor Lashmar Lagoon (-35.8074, 138.0645) that resolve-pin returned
notes: Parks page lists no day-entry fee, only camping from $19.80 per night (fees paid before entry); treated as free. Page title 'Lashmar... - National Parks and Wildlife Service South Australia'.

kangaroo-island-34.name: Cape Gantheaume Conservation Park
kangaroo-island-34.bio: A large coastal wilderness park on the south coast, with Murray Lagoon, D'Estrees Bay and walking trails.
kangaroo-island-34.coordinates_source: MEDIUM: OSM tourism=camp_site 'D'estrees Bay Camp Ground' (Photon), the park's D'Estrees Bay visitor point; the reserve centroids (-35.918, 137.415 and -36.009, 137.483) were rejected
notes: Parks page lists no day-entry fee, only camping from $19.80 per night; treated as free. The page covers the Conservation Park and Wilderness Protection Area. Page URL 'cape-gantheaume-conservation-park' (without the suffix) is a 404; the suffixed URL is the right one. The campground is the nearest visitor-facility point I could source; the park is large and has no visitor centre. The pin is 2.6 km from the Murray Lagoon pin, which is a different part of the park.

kangaroo-island-35.name: Murray Lagoon
kangaroo-island-35.bio: The island's largest lagoon, a wetland in Cape Gantheaume Conservation Park known for its birdlife, with short walks.
kangaroo-island-35.coordinates_source: resolve-pin reported LOW (single source): Photon OSM water=lake 'Murray Lagoon' at 155 m from the Wikivoyage listing's own geotag (-35.9108, 137.4185), so two sources agree. A lake centroid is in the water, which is correct for a lagoon.
kangaroo-island-35.ticket_note: Part of Cape Gantheaume Conservation Park; no separate steward page.
notes: pin: LOW per resolve-pin (kept because the lake feature and the Wikivoyage listing agree within 155 m). The park page says the Murray Lagoon trails may flood in winter. Walks to Bald Hill and Timber Creek (half an hour to an hour) start at the lagoon.

kangaroo-island-36.name: Bald Hill Walk
kangaroo-island-36.bio: A short walk to Bald Hill, with views over Murray Lagoon and a chance to watch wetland birds.
kangaroo-island-36.coordinates_source: MEDIUM: OSM tourism=viewpoint 'Bald Hill' (Photon), 150 m from a Commons file geotagged 'Murray Lagoon from Bald Hill trail' (-35.9003, 137.4348). Pinned on the viewpoint, not the route midpoint; the OSM 'Bald Hill Track' footway is at -35.8992, 137.4366.
kangaroo-island-36.ticket_note: Part of Cape Gantheaume Conservation Park; no separate steward page.
notes: Renamed from 'Bald Hill Walk (Cape Gantheaume)': the park qualifier is dropped per the naming rule. The walk's length is not given in any source read, so the visit range follows the draft (30 min to 1 hr).

Hog Bay: 600 m beach length and the French monument claim from the draft are unsourced and were cut.
Frenchmans Rock: whether the displayed rock is the original is not stated.
Lashmar and Cape Gantheaume Conservation Parks: no day-entry fee listed on the parks pages; treated as free.
notes: Pins: kangaroo-island-30 (Fireball Bates trail) is LOW, pinned at the visitor-centre trailhead because the route is not in OpenStreetMap. kangaroo-island-35 (Murray Lagoon) came back LOW from resolve-pin but two sources agree within 155 m. Cape Gantheaume (34), Lashmar (33) and Bald Hill (36) use OSM visitor-point features found through Photon, because Nominatim was rate-limited (429) for most of the run and Overpass was refusing connections.
All 12 spots are kept; none judged unfit to add.
